description: This file defines a BroadcastReceiver class named DebugReceiver that logs Bluetooth-related broadcast intents and their extras to logcat. It includes a method to abbreviate the intent action and extra keys for concise logging.

classes.name: DebugReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that logs Bluetooth intents and their extras for debugging purposes.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles received broadcast intents, logs the action and extras with shortened keys.

methods.name: shorten
methods.description: Abbreviates parts of the intent action and extra keys for concise logging by replacing common package prefixes.
